heroHeadline: Day 373: BJP Falls Silent on RSS Dialogue Overture — India Rejects PCA Ruling as IWT Legal War Intensifies
heroSubtitle: May 18, 2026: The BJP government maintained conspicuous silence as India's ideological parent organisation, the RSS, called for people-to-people dialogue with Pakistan — with former J&K Chief Ministers Farooq Abdullah and Mehbooba Mufti rallying behind resumed talks. India simultaneously rejected the Permanent Court of Arbitration's May 15 supplemental award on the Indus Waters Treaty as 'null and void,' while Pakistan hailed it as a 'huge legal win.' A 20-member US nuclear industry delegation arrived in New Delhi for civil nuclear cooperation talks (May 18–21) underscoring US-India strategic alignment amid the freeze. The ceasefire brokered May 10, 2025 holds at Day 373 with no Line of Control kinetic incidents. The bilateral freeze remains total: mutual airspace closure in force through May 24, Indus Waters Treaty suspended, no ambassadors exchanged, all trade halted.
footerNote: Data sourced from Indian MEA/MOD, Pakistan ISPR/MFA, UN Security Council, SIPRI, Crisis Group, HRW, Stimson Center
